method: Mobbin MCP searches by screen intent; images inspected, not metadata. Skeleton only: hierarchy, spacing, control anatomy, navigation. Never colors, logos, imagery, or copy voice.

observedMechanics: Large left-aligned page title (Summary) with a small avatar at top right; no eyebrow text above it.
Section header (Pinned) with a quiet trailing Edit action, then a vertical stack of white cards on a soft tinted canvas.
Each card: colored category label with glyph at top left, relative date at top right, one large tabular number with unit on the second row, a small data graphic on the right.
Card corner radius roughly 18px, spacing roughly 12px between cards, 16px horizontal page margin.
Floating bottom tab bar with two tabs plus a detached search circle; the tab bar floats over content.
Greeting in bold lowercase sentence at top, a horizontal week strip under it with today ringed.
Two side-by-side tall cards for the two daily rituals, one active with a single Begin button, one completed with result chips.
One wide reflection card below with prompt text and one dark circular action; only one primary action is visible per card.
Bottom tab bar with a large central plus capture button raised above the bar.
The question (How do you feel right now?) is the page title; the answer control is a ring about 60 percent of viewport width centered under it.
A four-up row of equal square quick actions with glyph above label sits directly under the ring.
Routine progress is a single card with a count at right (3 of 3 completed) rather than a stats grid.
Recording opens as a sheet: title and date centered at top, waveform band edge to edge across the middle with a vertical playhead and a time ruler under it.
Very large tabular timer (00:02.01) centered below the waveform, then a row of transport controls, then one round record/stop control centered at the bottom with Done at the right.
No pulsing indicator; recording state is carried by the moving waveform and the filled control.
Almost empty white sheet: close at top left, Save at top right, a soft wave band in the lower third, a single round stop control with the elapsed time in a small filled label under it.
Whitespace is the design; the only saturated element is the stop control.
Three text tabs (My notes, Transcript, Summary) under the title bar switch the body; the summary is bulleted prose followed by an Action items section.
Body copy is a calm 16 to 17px with generous line height; no cards around the prose.
Recording controls persist as a floating dark capsule above the bottom sheet.
The user's original text stays on top in plain body type; the AI note (ABY Noticed) rises as a separate sheet from the bottom with its own title and close control.
The AI text is visually separated from the source by the sheet boundary, never interleaved with it.
Title, then a metadata row (date, duration, owner) in small secondary type, then a tab row (Summary, Transcript, AI Chat, Comments).

Each transcript paragraph starts with a colored speaker avatar circle, the speaker name in that color, and the timestamp in secondary type on the same line; the spoken text is a plain paragraph beneath.
A playback scrubber with elapsed and total time and a centered play control is pinned to the bottom.

references.screen: Session detail: summary linked to source
observedMechanics: Segmented control (Transcript, Notes, Summary, Attachments) above the body.
Each transcript block is a two-column row: timestamp in a narrow left column, text in the wide right column, aligned to a shared baseline.
Collapsible section headers (Recently assigned, Do today, Do next week, Do later) with a count at right and a disclosure chevron at left.
Rows are one line of title with an optional secondary line, a circular check control at left, and a date at right; hairline dividers, no cards.
One pinned primary action (New task) at bottom right.
Each row carries a second line of small metadata (date, source workspace glyph and name) under the title, which is the pattern Candy Corn adapts for goal provenance.
Completion state is a filled blue check circle; incomplete is an empty circle with a hairline.
A dark period-insights band at top (Entries, Avg sleep, Avg stress in three columns) with a Filter and a period selector.
Day header (Today, 19 Jul) with a chevron, then white entry cards each with a small type glyph and label, a time at right, the prompt in secondary type, and the entry excerpt in body type.
Entry cards are the only cards; headers sit directly on the canvas.
Vertical timeline: each day gets a date block (large day number over month) at left with a relative label beside it; entries hang beneath it as compact rows with a colored mood glyph at left.
Rows are short: one title line and one metadata line.
Bottom sheet with a single glyph, a title, one line of explanation, then labeled toggle rows each with a one-line reason, then one full-width primary button.
The sheet is white on a dimmed page; nothing else competes.
Progress segments at top, a centered title and one sentence of reason, a single flat illustration, and one full-width Continue button pinned at the sheet bottom.
The permission screen is given full-screen craft rather than a system dialog alone.
A brief written as prose: a large heading sentence, then short statements separated by hairlines, with the patient's own data highlighted inline by a soft tinted background.
One pinned full-width Continue button; no cards, no icons, the text is the object.
A centered navigation title sits above a short ledger of plain settings rows; each primary control remains a full 44px-tall row rather than a compact switch floating by itself.
The AI-sharing row names the external processor directly and places a concrete explanation immediately beneath the control.
Long privacy consequences stay in readable body copy within the same section, while policy destinations form a separate two-row list with trailing chevrons.
Groups are separated by generous vertical space and bounded surfaces; there is no metrics grid or decorative privacy illustration.
The confirmation screen keeps a visible thumbnail of the photographed source beside the extracted subtotal and tax values.
Extracted content is presented as editable structured rows below the source preview, with the original image remaining separately identifiable.
A single full-width confirmation action is pinned at the bottom after the user can inspect and amend the extraction.
The source preview, extracted values, and correction action have distinct hierarchy, so extraction never visually replaces the original.
